brief.decision_need: Decide which core Assistant behavior gaps need investigation before treating the current configuration as a dependable development baseline.
brief.uncertainty: The Assistant may route or interpret ordinary wallet requests incorrectly, lose conversational state, guess under ambiguity, mishandle formatted amounts, or repeat a posted effect.
brief.governing_question: Within the selected diagnostic scenarios, does the Wallet Assistant route requests, preserve conversation state, clarify underdetermined input, extract important fields, and avoid repeating an already posted effect as expected?
brief.sut_boundary: The local Wallet conversation control layer and its wallet_state and transaction_capture AI capabilities, including the configured Ollama model and in-memory Wallet services.
expected_behavior: A wallet-state request returns the recorded account balances without starting transaction capture.
Clear transaction requests preserve type, amount, account, category, and interaction context.
Underdetermined or ambiguous requests produce a question instead of a guessed candidate or product-visible processing failure.
A follow-up contribution completes the active draft without losing previously supplied fields.
A request to repeat a completed transaction does not silently create a second effect from private draft memory.
brief.scope: Exactly eight synthetic cases from workbench-check-8, executed once in isolated in-memory Wallet state under the model and SUT revision recorded in the execution artifact.
limitations: The cohort is deliberately diagnostic and does not estimate production frequency or overall Wallet quality.
Each case is sampled once, so the result does not measure model-output variance.
The deterministic checks cover declared observable properties only and do not replace full domain-expert trace review.
The execution provenance may identify a dirty local Wallet worktree; findings apply only to the captured revision and working state.

cases.criterion: A direct request for current wallet state returns a wallet-state view with the seeded balances and does not fail publicly.

checks.description: Wallet completes the request without a public HTTP error
Wallet returns a state-shown outcome
The response exposes the wallet-state view
The ARS total preserves both seeded ARS account balances

cases.criterion: A clear expense request produces a confirmation preview whose structured candidate preserves the declared amount, type, account, and category.

checks.description: Wallet completes interpretation without a public HTTP error
Wallet produces one confirmation preview
The candidate is an expense
ARS 4,500 is represented as 450,000 minor units
The candidate uses Cash Wallet
The candidate uses Food > Groceries

cases.criterion: A transfer missing its destination preserves supplied fields and asks for the missing destination instead of guessing it.

checks.description: Wallet handles the incomplete request without a public HTTP error
Wallet asks a question
The supplied source account remains bound
The missing destination remains unknown

cases.criterion: A slot-only follow-up completes the existing transfer draft while preserving its source and amount.

checks.description: Both turns complete without a public HTTP error
The first turn asks for the endpoint and the follow-up produces a preview
The completed draft preserves Main account as source
The follow-up binds Cash Wallet as destination
The completed draft preserves ARS 120 as 12,000 minor units

cases.criterion: An internally corrected expense uses only the final amount and retains the other explicit fields.

checks.description: Wallet handles the correction without a public HTTP error
Wallet produces one confirmation preview
The final ARS 5,400 value is represented as 540,000 minor units
The corrected candidate remains an expense

cases.criterion: An ambiguous transfer source produces a clarification question without choosing an account or failing publicly.

checks.description: Wallet handles ambiguity without a public HTTP error
Wallet asks for clarification

cases.criterion: A monetary event with no determinate direction or transaction type produces a clarification question rather than a guessed transaction.

checks.description: Wallet handles the underdetermined event without a public HTTP error
Wallet asks the user to determine transaction meaning

cases.criterion: After one expense is confirmed, a reference-only repetition does not recreate the completed draft or post a second ledger effect.

checks.description: The full sequence completes without a public HTTP error
The expense is previewed and recorded, then the repetition remains a question
Only the explicitly confirmed expense changes the ledger
